Correct — this is just property taxation levels.  The total budget is $12 billion for Hillsborough County.  It was $6.6 billion in 2020.

So a reduction in tax revenue from homestead properties is a very small fraction of the total budget.


Tampa Bay Living (@TampaBay_Living)

I also think people need to know the total budget for the county is over 10 billion, so when they act like Homestead exemption is going to crash the county government it’s a fabrication designed to keep you paying taxes

Hillsborough County

2018 taxes — $853 million
2025 taxes — $1.6 billion

Population growth: 8%

61.2% of homesteads would have property taxes eliminated under initial $250k exemption.


Kim Hanson 🌺 (@Kimzer510)

Can you do Hillsborough Co plz



— https://nitter.net/Kimzer510/status/2061429285332652128#m

Pasco County 

2018 taxes — $251 million
2025 taxes — $609 million

Population growth: 25%.

65.2% of homesteads in Pasco will be completely exempt from property taxes under the initial $250k exemption.

70% of property tax revenue is non-homestead residential, investment properties and commercial.  

Eliminating all homestead revenue immediately would still yield revenue 30% higher than what local governments taxed in 2019.


JustJM (@infl_jm)

so once again, explain to people who owns property in Florida and DO NOT homestead? And will continue to pay taxes. Critics are allowing voters to think every service will be eliminated because no one pays tax.



— https://nitter.net/infl_jm/status/2061

60% of homestead properties will be completely exempt from property taxes under the new Save Our Homes, yet the remaining local government revenue would be the equivalent of 2024 levels — which is still a massive increase over 2019 levels.  

And yet Save Our Homes creates a state fund that will provide grants to local governments for public safety, education and other core services.


Ron DeSantis (@RonDeSantis)

Local governments took $32 billion in property taxes in 2019.

Today, they are tak

Broward County

2018 taxes — $1.08 billion
2025 taxes — $1.8 billion

Population growth 2018-2025: 3.5%

51.8% of homestead properties in Broward will be fully exempt under the initial $250k exemption.

Local governments took $32 billion in property taxes in 2019.

Today, they are taking $60 billion.  

Meanwhile, at the state level, Florida has reduced spending four years in a row — even though we’ve had both inflation and population growth.

Exempting homesteads can be done.  And it it will help millions of Floridians.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

JUST IN: Governor DeSantis leads the charge to eliminate property taxes in Florida under a new plan aimed at giving homeowners relief.

Yes.  Let’s say that the $32 billion from 2019 was free of overspending (which is, of course, not a good assumption).  Inflation + population growth would not justify tax revenue taken from property owners to nearly double.


Triarius The Exile (@AdamWilday)

$32 billion in 2019 dollars is equivalent to approximately $41.68 billion in 2026 dollars. So a $20b gap.



— https://nitter.net/AdamWilday/status/2061204783457853684#m

Protect taxpayers!


Enrique García (@emgarciax)

Local governments in Florida feasted on close to double the property taxes collected from $32 billion (2019) to $60 billion.
That’s an insane amount of money based on unrealized estimated earnings (property valuation), not actual.
So, once and for all, it’s due time to adjust according to the circumstances, time to stop spending like a drunken sailor.
Of course, most politicians hate to see money get taken away from their hands / control / pet pr

W. Stainton (@GatorWill78)

Andy Yochum (@AndyYochum)

— https://nitter.net/AndyYochum/status/2061073910028759246#m

The Prosecutor (@TheProsecutor15)

The Georgia Peach



— https://nitter.net/TheProsecutor15/status/2061048616769159396#m

Accurate.


The Ghost (@revolt777)

Local governments in Florida have nearly doubled their property tax hauls—from $32 billion in 2019 to around $60 billion now. That’s an enormous sum built on paper valuations and unrealized gains, not actual cash in people’s pockets.
It’s long past time to recalibrate to reality



— https://nitter.net/revolt777/status/2060874917336219870#m

Missing Iron Horse, Yankee Clipper, Shoeless Joe, The Kid, among others.
